qualification.browser: Playwright lockfile Chromium revision; record launched version

workstreams.implementation: Keep a release-SHA/base-SHA/WAR-hash evidence manifest and assign every changed path, removed API, migration, resource and test-helper change to an executable check or explicit reviewed exclusion. Preserve the main-only commit inventory.
workstreams.cases: Full Git diff, renamed/deleted/binary paths, files beyond the GitHub compare 300-file cap; wrong commit, stale build, absent artifact and changed source after build must fail.
workstreams.acceptance: No unowned production path; all required evidence belongs to the same release SHA and packaged bytes; current-main and older-workspace-main scopes remain distinct.

workstreams.implementation: Add an opt-in strict release mode and a Node result gate. Treat required SKIP, known-fail, unexpected-pass, TODO, cancellation, empty selection, missing structured result, timeout and cleanup failure as incomplete verification. Retain the existing diagnostic classifications.
workstreams.cases: Exercise the outcome truth table using real child exit statuses and malformed/missing JUnit; cleanup failure overrides SKIP/known-fail; duplicate names, omitted shards and profile/province filters cannot hide checks.
workstreams.acceptance: All 29 active and five retired browser expectations and five retired Node TODOs receive a fresh disposition; an ordinary exit 0 is insufficient for release completion.

workstreams.implementation: Generate fresh JaCoCo reports in the authoritative test lane, collect changed-line instruction/branch misses, and enforce a reviewed diff coverage gate. Add source/SHA freshness checks and test-source-to-report discovery reconciliation. Keep Sonar failure-ignore analysis separate from the test verdict.
workstreams.cases: Partially covered lines, unexecuted branches, missing classes, stale reports for the same filenames, new/removed/renamed tests, parameterized/nested/dynamic tests, empty reports and intentional non-executable changes.
workstreams.acceptance: Collect fresh instruction/branch/partial-line and discovery baselines first. Ratchet reviewed per-file floors from those baselines; every security/data-integrity refusal needs a named passing case. Unmapped executable lines or missing reports block readiness; 90/85 was a proposal, not a justified universal threshold.

workstreams.implementation: Add the transaction and projection families omitted by the current *Dao*/*DAO* native selection. Adapt hard-coded H2 configurations where needed; require their report families explicitly. Run generated-schema and actual Flyway ON/BC variants.
workstreams.cases: MariaDB 11.8.8, production SQL modes/collations/isolation, 32 KiB page configuration for wide legacy forms, committed reads through independent connections, missing native opt-in and missing reports.
workstreams.acceptance: All required native families execute without prerequisite skips; H2 success and generated-schema success cannot stand in for a shipped-schema result.

workstreams.area: Prescription batch atomicity and ambiguous saves
workstreams.implementation: Extend the real-DB rollback proof to native MariaDB and the installed application. Preserve existing tests for new, corrected and mixed cards; add driver/commit uncertainty and duplicate request interleavings rather than duplicating mock assertions.
workstreams.cases: Failure after script header, first/second drug, partial date, reason and archival; audit only after commit; known rollback restores original IDs/revisions and values; uncertain commit keeps the draft consumed; retry and double-click never duplicate rows, signatures, prints or faxes.
workstreams.acceptance: Committed state is complete exactly once, confirmed rollback leaves zero partial rows, and lost-response UI tells the truth. Finding 334 remains blocking until fixed and its expected-failure pins are retired.

workstreams.implementation: Run the existing header/ordinary/text/commit rollback matrix on the BC Flyway schema and extend preservation/authorization cases at actual batch boundaries.
workstreams.cases: 0/1/49/50/51/100+ fields; pages and global fields; unchecked/blank/long Unicode text; prior-version author and edit timestamps; missing/foreign source form; failures after both flush/clear boundaries; Save/Save and Exit navigate only after commit.
workstreams.acceptance: Old version remains byte/value-equivalent, successful new versions contain every intended field, failed versions leave neither headers nor either child-table group.

workstreams.implementation: Keep the existing concurrent-instance/process and provenance regressions. Add service-account, installed restart, disk/write failure and encrypted-data round-trip qualification.
workstreams.cases: Existing/missing/blank keys; external override versus bundled configuration; changed override property after load; read-only/missing file; trailing continuation and non-ASCII properties; concurrent processes; permission/owner preservation; process interruption; existing encrypted fax/config data before and after restart.
workstreams.acceptance: A single persisted key is reused, existing ciphertext remains readable, and failed persistence aborts startup before any ephemeral key or partial configuration is used.

workstreams.area: REST XML, JSON and content negotiation
workstreams.implementation: Extend the existing installed REST check to nonempty XML allergy/prevention date DTOs and every supported precision, plus restricted-user/error and OAuth surfaces. Preserve production mapper and both JAXB provider tests.
workstreams.cases: Accept application/xml, application/json and */*; UNKNOWN/YEAR/MONTH/FULL_DATE, leap days, nulls and epoch values in UTC/Toronto/Tokyo; 400/401/403/404; malformed or foreign patient; exact field names and precision shapes; shared provider initialization must not fall back silently.
workstreams.acceptance: Old supported JSON contracts and valid XML resources retain their semantic payloads, content types and authorization behavior without HTML/empty-success fallback.

workstreams.implementation: Qualify full/status/type/urgency edits with omitted/null/blank editVersion compatibility, explicit stale conflicts, row locking and committed archive/audit behavior.
workstreams.cases: Full edit plus status/type/urgency routes; omitted/null/blank token preserves legacy compatibility; invalid request 400, stale token 409, missing row 404; legacy null timestamp; multiple writes in one second; bulk and legacy-JDBC updates invalidate tokens; one winner under contention; original audit fields preserved; failed mutation rolls back archive and audit.
workstreams.acceptance: No lost update or stray archive for versioned clients; omitted/null/blank tokens retain the supported legacy path. Refused/stale requests leave no mutation.

workstreams.area: Bulk schedule names and consultation projections
workstreams.implementation: Run the existing query-count/order/duplicate/orphan tests natively and add production-size, privilege and merged-patient boundary fixtures.
workstreams.cases: Empty, duplicate, missing and merged patients; Unicode names; batch boundary; every sort/filter and tied page boundary; duplicate extension rows; fax history; permission/site/program restrictions; fixed query count as row count grows.
workstreams.acceptance: Visible rows, ordering and patient privacy match the approved contract and query counts do not grow per row or type.

workstreams.implementation: Add persisted attachment/permission interleavings under the consultation lock and real preview/print/fax packet assertions, using capture-only fax fixtures.
workstreams.cases: Unavailable FORM/HRM rows retained on unrelated saves; deliberate visible removal works; new hidden/foreign attachment refused; regional restrictions; permissions change between picker and submit; missing reports; localized omission notice in every output; no hidden ID/title/type/count disclosure.
workstreams.acceptance: No attachment silently disappears, no restricted content is exported, and omitted material is honestly disclosed without leaking metadata.

workstreams.implementation: Keep existing installed trigger-based rollback proof; add genuine concurrent ID allocation and independent-connection checks for queue, security object and default property writes.
workstreams.cases: Two insertions interleave, duplicate names, generated-ID absence, queue insert failure, security-object failure, default preference failure, retry after rollback and preserved prior default.
workstreams.acceptance: Every reference names the queue actually inserted by that transaction; no MAX(id) surrogate, orphan security row, success message after refusal, or wrong provider default.

workstreams.area: E-Chart save barriers, session and logout races
workstreams.implementation: Extend executed-JavaScript and real browser tests around pending CPP mutations, not merely refresh requests. Exercise each changed navbar action with concurrent logout.
workstreams.cases: Save/Sign/Exit while CPP is pending; success, 403, 409, 500, abort and delayed/out-of-order callback; queued save cancels on failure and recovers only explicitly; two charts/visits/providers; session invalidates between action stages; no extra chart/group issue lookups.
workstreams.acceptance: No stale note or CPP overwrite, cross-patient action, null-session 500, duplicate save or misleading saved state.

workstreams.area: Lab provenance, timestamps and clinical visibility
workstreams.implementation: Add native extension ambiguities and installed source-link authorization checks; retain the older-main timestamp/long measurement/import/routing regression sweep.
workstreams.cases: History, Health Tracker and flowsheets; null/duplicate/stale/invalid/overflow extension values; foreign-patient source lab; batched provenance query; older lab versions and merged patients; real HL7 observation/entry times at midnight/noon/23:59 and DST; long and partial results; missing public key.
workstreams.acceptance: Exact clinical values and timestamps persist; links open only authorized source reports, remain deterministic under duplicate data, and add no per-reading query or false error storm.

workstreams.area: Inbound fax backoff and resource lifecycle
workstreams.implementation: Extend the fake-clock backoff matrix and add scheduler/admin integration with a loopback provider, preserving existing streaming/dedup/transaction regressions.
workstreams.cases: 1/2/4/8/16/32/60 minute delays and counter saturation; account isolation, disable/remove/re-enable, restart reset, recovery transition logging; local document failure versus account outage; pending imports continue; concurrent status reads while provider stalls; retry UI and privilege gates.
workstreams.acceptance: No starving healthy accounts, double import, hidden permanent failure, leaked credential/provider body, stuck poll lock or accumulated spool file.

workstreams.area: BC typed DAO and transaction parity
workstreams.implementation: Extend native ON/BC qualification for all replaced raw-query consumers, using old-result fixtures as an independent oracle and the existing explicit transaction-boundary tests.
workstreams.cases: Invoices, payment/refund signs, remittance overpunch and decimals, WCB fees, missing/null lookup rows, exact versus wildcard payee semantics, patient/provider restrictions, date bounds and ordering; extract log/status failure rollback; REQUIRES_NEW semantics; BC-only page refusal on ON.
workstreams.acceptance: Amounts, claim state and visible rows match intended behavior without SQL coercion differences, lost precision or unauthorized cross-province access.

workstreams.implementation: Expand machine-readable contract fixtures and installed download checks, documenting intentional remittance/XLSX layout changes instead of silently accepting them as backward compatible.
workstreams.cases: All CSV reports and 22-column remittance summary; every row type; refund subsets/net totals; date aging edges; 0 versus null; leading zeros; commas/quotes/CRLF/Unicode; formula prefixes after whitespace/control characters; SXSSF flush/row limits; query/disk/stream errors before response attachment; temp cleanup.
workstreams.acceptance: No missing rows, columns, totals or text, formulas never execute, and generation failure cannot produce a partial successful attachment. Breaking layout changes have an explicit consumer migration decision.

workstreams.area: PDF engines, fonts and print/fax layouts
workstreams.implementation: Rerun the established before/after PDF corpus on the final packaged WAR; extend renderer security and concurrency, and preserve the already-added half-letter browser dimension/content assertions.
workstreams.cases: A4/Letter/A6/396x612 half-letter, print/reprint/fax, auto-print, signatures, long patient/pharmacy headers, all Rourke/BC/legacy forms, long notes and checked marks, CJK/emoji/accents, no host fonts/unwritable font cache, PDF 2.0 consumers, Brotli input, warm-cache two-patient parallel rendering; Flying Saucer resource/network/path refusals.
workstreams.acceptance: No clipped, blank, overlapped or omitted clinical content, unsupported font fallback, cross-patient cache leakage, partial PDF success, SSRF or leaked temporary artifact.

workstreams.implementation: Preserve the extensive independent loopback HTTPS tests; run them against packaged classpath and qualify actual approved staging MCEDT/HCV deployment settings. Add a separate test for CXF-owned spill-cache retention rather than claiming application replay closure covers it.
workstreams.cases: Signed/encrypted SOAP/MTOM, exact bytes, TLS 1.2/1.3, mTLS/hostname/trust failures, proxy/auth, stalled/progressing/truncated bodies, plain/multipart fault chains, thread-local cleanup and concurrent clients; ordinary crypto properties remain readable, ENC(...) has explicit refusal; async/HTTP2/custom extensions inventoried.
workstreams.acceptance: Supported Ministry flows work on deployed transport and resources stay bounded. The documented pre-existing CXF spill-cache finding and unavailable staging credentials remain explicit unresolved gates. CXF-owned spill caches and vendor staging are separate required acceptance; replay-buffer cleanup alone is insufficient.

workstreams.implementation: Run the complete CDS matrix on the final JDK and WAR, keeping independent JDK-PSVI-versus-owned-metadata comparisons. Add any uncovered schema facets/namespace and runtime resume compatibility cases.
workstreams.cases: Same pinned XSDs; type inheritance, whitespace, fixed/enumerated/pattern values, xsi:type/rebound namespaces, IDs/IDREFs; DOCTYPE/XXE/schema fetch refusal; escaped text above JDK defaults; every resource limit at/beyond boundary; Unicode XML encodings; 64 MiB fresh JVM; greater-than-heap payloads, 20 GiB and ZIP64; disk full/cancel/restart/resume and sealed-hash mismatch.
workstreams.acceptance: No silently dropped/normalized clinical fields, external XML access, unbounded memory, partial publish or unsafe resume; native DB and installed web/CLI evidence agree.

workstreams.area: Dependency removals and shared utility compatibility
workstreams.implementation: Run existing differential vectors and add caller-level fixtures where removed libraries could alter data. Verify actual WAR contents, not only the POM, and qualify supported extensions against removed public APIs.
workstreams.cases: TOTP random keys/counter/locale boundaries; QR byte parity; Ant-compatible ISO parsing; null/blank/Unicode strings; encoding and collection/stream semantics; removed Velocity/raw JDBC APIs; all required CXF/JAXB modules; Drools, JavaMelody and Flyway; one OpenPDF; no banned Jasypt/Xerces/HTTP4/logging duplicates or missing runtime class.
workstreams.acceptance: Supported callers retain intended behavior and every intentional removal has a concrete compatibility disposition; dependency locks, classpath and packaged bytes agree.

workstreams.area: Response reset, filter ordering and failure privacy
workstreams.implementation: Keep the 13 deterministic embedded-Tomcat error cases and controls; add packaged nginx/Tomcat front-door qualification across real decorators and transport failure paths.
workstreams.cases: reset versus resetBuffer, configured and partial responses, committed stream, HTML/REST/PDF/redirect, forward/error dispatch, gzip/content length/cache, validation 400 preserved, server 500 sanitized, CSRF/logout/privacy/monitoring wrappers and JDBC release; disabled-filter controls prove the probe would detect a leak.
workstreams.acceptance: No stale body/header, HTML appended to PDF, swallowed validation error, credential/PHI diagnostic body, or cleanup before transaction completion. No production fault endpoint is introduced.

workstreams.area: Authorization, CSRF, patient and identity boundaries
workstreams.implementation: Extend actor-object-patient matrices to every changed action/endpoint and add the explicitly missing forged additional-review identity replay against AddEditDocument2Action/AddEditHtml2Action. Run current known authorization/XSS failures as blocking findings.
workstreams.cases: Anonymous/restricted/authorized users; own/foreign/locked/merged patient; valid actor-specific CSRF token; GET/HEAD versus POST; over-posted provider/reviewer/record identity; hidden links versus direct request; exact denial status and zero unauthorized row/file/audit-success writes; stored XSS fragments and trusted delimiter partitions. Forged reviewerId and extraReviewerId must not change the signed-in actor or historical first-review attribution.
workstreams.acceptance: Authorization is enforced server-side, denied actions produce no unauthorized state or hidden content, and finding 159 has a real failing-then-fixed regression instead of an untested assertion.

workstreams.implementation: Retain existing ownership-safe cleanup proofs and add an actual concurrent image-destination collision test. Cover Browse Notes deletion confirmation, replacement page counts and document links under failure.
workstreams.cases: Two writers to the same destination, symlink/replacement inode, accepted-but-unconfirmed upload, orphan route/queue/link failure, hidden/foreign references inserted after preflight, cancel/confirm delete, upload interruption, PDF corruption, annotation/fax handoff and scratch cleanup.
workstreams.acceptance: No replacement/truncation of another writer file, lost document, orphan route or false cleanup success. Current documented replacement semantics remain a product limitation until repaired.

workstreams.implementation: The six migrations V1.0.59.27 through V1.0.59.32 exist on both pinned heads; verify history, entity/manifest/consent behavior and supported upgrades. Preserve historical migration bytes; use forward repair if needed. Add upgrades from both older supported installs and the current main schema.
workstreams.cases: ON and BC fresh, N-1 upgrade, resumed OSCAR19 import; long text beyond former capacities, BCAR2007 urine culture, archive values/timestamps, duplicate/live consent history and idempotent reapply; pinned CLI/manifest/schema hashes; imported appointment name and RxSummary behavior. If a main-to-release path is unsupported, refuse before mutation.
workstreams.acceptance: No schema regression, silent truncation, consent/history loss, invalid migration history or omission of a main-side fix disguised as a release deletion. Recompute main-only migration inventory if either comparison head moves; any newly absent migration requires its exact hash and reviewed disposition. Published migrations remain byte-for-byte immutable.

workstreams.area: Debian installation, reinstall and dependency locks
workstreams.implementation: Run real clean-install, predecessor-upgrade, reconfigure and data-preserving reinstall on the supported packaged OS; reconcile main-only host/MariaDB recovery fixes. Test both app and DrugRef locks and pinned carlos-ctl 1.3.0.
workstreams.cases: Installed version/build identity; MariaDB system tables and existing clinical datadir; IPv4/IPv6 nginx default sites; ports in use; cert renewal, service user/modes/paths; paused import guard; dependency-lock enforcement; app/DrugRef startup; failed configure and recovery; published predecessor version layouts; no source-copied fixtures substituted for package files.
workstreams.acceptance: Fresh install and supported upgrade/reinstall preserve data, configuration and keys, restore service correctly, and exercise the actual built .deb/WAR and pinned CLI.

workstreams.implementation: Extend real save/reopen/print workflows for every changed form and eForm resource. Keep saved primary state distinct from failed email/PDF/fax/EDoc work and assert visible, retry-safe recovery.
workstreams.cases: Unticked/checked/blank/long/multiline/quoted/Unicode data; autosave pending/error and multiple clicks; form version and refresh; editor toolbar/Bootstrap/jQuery aliases/AP values/calendar/signature; Mac ZIPs, bounded bulk export, path and collision attacks; primary save succeeds then secondary preparation fails; expired email draft.
workstreams.acceptance: All entered values survive reopen and print, no duplicate primary save on retry, and the user sees exactly which operation failed with no clinical diagnostic disclosure.

workstreams.area: Clinical rules, preventions and measurement UI
workstreams.implementation: Execute actual clinical JavaScript and persisted workflows for the older-main form/measurement/prevention/rule changes; promote the HDL defect regressions once the product is fixed.
workstreams.cases: Framingham/UKPDS HDL equal/greater than total and stale-answer clearing; renal thresholds/source selection; WHtR and waist units; valid/impossible dates and leap/DST days; missing patient/catalog/rules; age/sex/hide filters; shared/private/null flowsheet scopes; selected preventions in print; duplicate linked diagnosis/drug and intact long lab values.
workstreams.acceptance: Clinical calculations use the intended inputs, invalid input clears stale results, persisted dates/values are exact, and no missing-data case logs an error per prevention type.

workstreams.implementation: Run current multi-window messaging and local mail-capture workflows, and verify the separate restricted reporting connection after the JDBC cleanup refactor.
workstreams.cases: Refused reply preserves body/recipients/attachments; multiline forward; encrypted MIME boundary; Send and Archive commits one message with correct archive; overlength fields rejected rather than truncated; attachments belong to email patient; QBE can read only approved reporting views and cannot write or use clinical-account privileges.
workstreams.acceptance: No lost draft, duplicate send, hidden attachment disclosure, clinical payload in diagnostics, silent truncation or privilege escalation through report connections.

workstreams.area: Profile, locale, dialogs and browser matrix
workstreams.implementation: Run applicable ON/BC suites plus real multisite, CAISI-admin, no-pin, address-lock, private-consent, appointment-options and supported legacy profiles. Add blocking rules for serious changed-surface accessibility defects and retain report-only findings separately.
workstreams.cases: Chromium full applicable suite; Firefox/WebKit login/chart-save/Rx/appointments/attachments/print critical paths where supported; desktop and small-screen hit tests; keyboard/focus/calendar/dialog Cancel/Escape; en/fr/es/pl/pt-BR; site/provider role visibility and exact configuration restoration. Required counts: three clean full packaged runs for #5577; 50 isolated packaged repetitions of the messenger-group-admin mocked-removal rollback interaction for #5566. Record exact Node 22, npm 10.9.9, browser and locale versions. No retry-to-green.
workstreams.acceptance: Every supported profile has actual prerequisites and executed assertions; unsupported/client-mode decisions, missing fax/import/corpus/tooling and blocked CAISI steps remain visible rather than synthetic passes.

workstreams.implementation: Perform the final-source real-OS-signal inventory on applicable mutating check families. Extend unit tests only for newly found gaps; retain exact ownership/byte guards and fatal cleanup outcomes.
workstreams.cases: Before/after accepted SQL/app writes, upload chunks, delayed response, shutdown and cleanup; both SIGINT and SIGTERM; exit 130/interrupted structured outcome; owned versus foreign SQL references; file bytes/type/inode/owner/mode; configs and new defaults restored; killed-run reconciliation and process groups. Exercise real SIGINT/SIGTERM and crash/SIGKILL where cleanup/recovery is promised. Serialize every global profile and verify owned-row snapshots and exact restoration.
workstreams.acceptance: No unreported residue or destructive cleanup. Historical 65-check SIGINT evidence and handler injection are not accepted as a new final-source SIGINT/SIGTERM inventory.

workstreams.implementation: Produce a required result for every known finding and retire expectations only after a current-build positive retake. Keep unavailable evidence and intentionally unsupported features distinct from fixed behavior.
workstreams.cases: Authorization/XSS/audit failures, clinical calculators, ambiguous Rx save response, API-key creation, consent/delete confirmation, pagination, profile/CAISI blockers; forged review identity; image-upload collision; EBS cache/staging prerequisites; #4102 races only against implementations actually present on the target branch.
workstreams.acceptance: A claim that all work is correct requires all applicable blockers resolved. Test-only improvements cannot convert a reproduced product defect into a pass or certify absent develop-only features.

workstreams.implementation: Add actual captured-log privacy assertions and bounded load/soak qualification for changed resource owners, using calibrated budgets and independent state checks.
workstreams.cases: Small/large datasets and concurrency for names/consultations/preventions/source links; DB connections, threads, heap, files and descriptor counts before/after success/failure/cancel; redeploy/shutdown; synthetic secret and clinical marker absent from logs/reports; expected fault logs scoped to their request.
workstreams.acceptance: Resources return to defined bounds and every required error/audit signal appears without patient/credential contents; no blanket clean-log claim based on a narrow sample.

workstreams.implementation: Rerun supported feature contracts for all release work already promoted to live main, as well as the recent release-only delta; map unmatched paths to a concrete family before closing evidence.
workstreams.cases: Patient create/edit/merge/history; chart notes/CPP/pregnancy; prescribing/allergies/drug lookup; appointments/groups/recurrence/slot locks; ON/BC billing and payment; labs/HRM/inbox; forms/eForms/documents/ticklers; contacts/messaging; provider/security/admin; OAuth/REST/ChartSpace; reports/export and clinical rules.
workstreams.acceptance: No changed feature is omitted because it happens to be common to live main and release. File routing and test counts are traceability aids, not proof that its assertions ran or are sufficient.

workstreams.implementation: Use the existing real nginx/ModSecurity/CRS harness, config and generated inventory checks; repeat accepted clinical prose through installed saves and compare byte-exact persisted content.
workstreams.cases: Positive and negative route/method/parameter scoping; transport encodings, literal/numeric field namespaces, script injection, request/response inspection, no unrelated 404 or upstream error accepted.
workstreams.acceptance: Real-engine decisions correlate to upstream receipts; installed saves preserve exact content and hostile payloads remain blocked.

workstreams.implementation: Exercise real restic snapshots, list and restore with nested credential canaries and non-secret import ledgers; check retention and symlink-safe purge in a disposable installed package.
workstreams.cases: Fresh/partial/failed snapshots; literal and recursive exclusion globs; repository/password/database credential exclusion; immutable source snapshots and migration ledgers retained; restore equality; retention, interruption and outside-root symlinks.
workstreams.acceptance: Restored files match synthetic originals, no credential canary enters any snapshot, and failed backups/purge do not mutate unrelated state.

workstreams.implementation: Retain Java security/MFA/token unit families and qualify session/OAuth authorization on installed default, no-PIN and address-lock profiles.
workstreams.cases: MFA replay/expiry/reset, lockout/reset/session invalidation; missing/revoked/expired tokens; authorization after import; no principal or patient spoofing; 401/403 and unchanged state.
workstreams.acceptance: Token/session lifetimes and revocation remain enforced across supported authentication and migrated OAuth clients.

workstreams.implementation: Retain defensive-copy and bounded cache tests; verify concurrent readers, reload publication and privilege invalidation through public production readers.
workstreams.cases: Mutation of returned collections; simultaneous reload/read; failure during refresh; deleted/changed privilege and cross-patient keys; bounded cache resources.
workstreams.acceptance: Readers see complete snapshots and current privileges without stale authorization, shared mutable state or cross-patient results.

workstreams.implementation: Add a physical MariaDB patient-merge rollback/concurrency lane and preserve explicit invalid-pagination and quick-list denial contracts.
workstreams.cases: Late merge failure, lock contention, deadlock victim rollback, cycles, duplicate merges; invalid list pagination 400; quick-list role denial 403; failed mutations preserve all prior state. Merge/unmerge audit rows must be committed and visible from an independent connection; an after-commit callback interaction alone is insufficient.
workstreams.acceptance: Each committed merge is complete once; refused or failed requests leave zero partial writes and return the documented status.

workstreams.implementation: Compile production JSPs with the Tomcat 11 Jasper profile, map JSP fragment includes to parent routes, execute actual production JS and retain source-bound coverage.
workstreams.cases: All changed JSP/JS paths including inline scripts, includes, removed resources and error routes; ON/BC, locale and authenticated/restricted renders; code ranges, source hashes and unmatched files.
workstreams.acceptance: No changed executable source disappears from discovery; isolated DOM fixtures are labelled separately from installed HTTP/render/persistence acceptance.

Framingham refuses HDL above total cholesterol and clears stale risk

checks.reason: Fresh changed-line instruction/branch floors, complete Java discovery reconciliation, production-JS ranges and JSP parent-route mapping; approve baseline-derived ratchets.
Every older-main/current-main/release-only changed path and all six main-only migrations need named executable coverage or an individually reviewed disposition.
Service-account write failures, interruption, concurrent startup and encrypted-data round trip after installed restart.
Unchanged supported clients for JSON/XML/OAuth, appointment editVersion, export formula protection, PDF geometry, removed dependencies and endpoints; explicitly decide intentional breaks.
Packaged TLS SOAP/MTOM/WS-Security, actual CXF-owned spill cache and vendor staging using authorized test credentials.
Existing CDS native/container/disk/WAF harnesses on the same candidate: 20 GiB/ZIP64, 32-bit boundaries, resume/crash and bounded memory/disk evidence.
Clean, upgrade and reinstall the candidate .deb with prior state, immutable migrations, config/keys, package dependency lock and unsupported-upgrade refusal.
Real installed backup/restore/retention/interruption, credential canaries and symlink-safe purge in a disposable VM.
Resolve supported overwrite behavior and qualify concurrent uploads, file/DB rollback and authorized same-name writes without silently changing the product contract.
Actual SIGINT/SIGTERM and promised SIGKILL recovery; owned snapshots restored; serialize global profiles; no retry-to-green.
Same-WAR resource budgets, independent clinical oracles, controlled mutation/fault sensitivity and privacy log review.
Requires candidate-bound first-login installation-stage evidence before the shared administrator has been reset; post-install browser runs cannot supply this proof.
